items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Matches the reference: `if auth: netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])`, with a two-line comment explaining why. It uses the existing names and single-quote style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The utils.py change is minimal and uses parse_url's `auth` field. But the patch also deletes the unrelated files docs/dev/authors.rst and docs/dev/contributing.rst. The action log shows no command that deleted them, so this may be an environment artifact, but it is still unrelated churn in the submitted diff.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The `if auth:` guard only adds credentials when they are present. There are no new error paths, no magic constants and no hardcoded secrets. Hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged and the fix only re-attaches the auth that parse_url already returns. There are no urllib3 or Python-version checks. The manual check shows `example.com/path` still becomes `http://example.com/path`.
